orderedCatalogs.policy: DCEU only (Warner Bros. DC Extended Universe, 2013-2023), in in-universe story order. This is the order TheWrap, TechRadar and TechAdvisor use: Wonder Woman (1918), WW84 (1984), Man of Steel, BvS, Suicide Squad, Justice League with Zack Snyder's Justice League beside it as an alternate cut, Aquaman, Shazam!, Birds of Prey, The Suicide Squad, Peacemaker, Black Adam, Shazam! Fury of the Gods, The Fl

https://www.techradar.com/how-to/how-to-watch-the-dceu-movies-in-order (places Peacemaker after The Suicide Squad and Blue Beetle after The Flash)

orderedCatalogs.policy: DC Studios DCU Chapter One in story order. Release order per James Gunn, except Clayface: Gunn says it is set before Superman, and it is the origin of the Clayface seen in Creature Commandos (superbromovies.com DCU timeline).
sources: https://nerdist.com/article/james-gunn-confirms-dcu-timeline-release-order/ (Gunn, May 2025: DCU timeline is basically release order; names Creature Commandos, Superman, Peacemaker, Lanterns, Supergirl)

https://superbromovies.com/2026/09/28/dcu-timeline/ (release order with dates: Creature Commandos, Superman, Peacemaker S2, Supergirl Jun 26 2026, Lanterns Aug 16-Oct 4 2026, Clayface Oct 23 2026; Man of Tomorrow Jul 9 2027; undated projects)
